credits.text: Stormlight journey events written for this guide from the Coppermind's chapter summaries
Journey data adapted from the 17th Shard's Roshar map (MIT)

events.title: Shallan is born into House Davar

summary.text: Shallan was born in Jah Keved, into House Davar.
Shallan was born in Jah Keved to Lin Davar.
Shallan was born around 1156 in Jah Keved to Lin Davar.
Shallan was born around 1156 to Lin Davar and his wife, secretly the Herald Chana.
Dalinar is born around 1120.
Dalinar is born around 1120, the second son of the Kholin family.

events.title: Shallan bonds a spren as a child

summary.text: As a child, Shallan bonded a spren.
As a child, Shallan bonded Testament, then abandoned the bond, leaving Testament a deadeye.
As a child, Shallan bonded the Cryptic Testament; she later partly severed the bond, leaving Testament a deadeye.
As a child, Shallan drew the Cryptic Testament; she later partly severed their bond, leaving Testament a deadeye.
Dalinar follows his older brother Gavilar into a war to unite Alethkar under the Kholin banner.
Shallan's mother and a man died at the Davar estate.
Shallan killed her mother in self-defence; her father took the blame.
Shallan killed her mother with Testament in self-defence; her father took the blame.
Shallan's mother, the Herald Chana, tried to kill her at Nale's urging; Shallan struck down Chana and Dreder.

art.alt: A frightened boy kneels holding a huge Shardblade, while an armoured figure with a bloodied axe stands over him.

summary.text: Dalinar attacks Rathalas, the Rift, and kills Brightlord Tanalan. He spares Tanalan's widow and young son, and takes the Shardblade, Oathbringer.

events.title: Shallan's father is accused of murder

summary.text: Redin accused Lin Davar of murdering his first wife.

Attacking Highprince Kalanor, Dalinar is so lost in the Thrill that he kills his own men. He wins Kalanor's Shards in a duel, then turns on Gavilar, stopping only when his brother takes off his helm and smiles. Ashamed, he gives Gavilar the Shards.

events.title: Shallan meets a stranger at Middlefest

summary.text: At the Middlefest Fair, Shallan met a messenger from Helaran.
At the Middlefest Fair, Shallan met Wit, who brought word from Helaran.

art.alt: Dalinar cradles his newborn son, smiling, as Evi watches from the bed.

summary.text: Called away from a wrestling match when Evi goes into labour, Dalinar is overjoyed at the birth of their son, Adolin.
Shallan's father died, leaving House Davar in debt.
Shallan killed her father, leaving House Davar in debt.
After Lin Davar killed Malise, Shallan killed him.

art.alt: Dalinar cradles his newborn son, smiling, as Evi watches from the bed.

summary.text: Adolin is born in Kholinar, to Dalinar's joy.
Shallan left Jah Keved to steal Jasnah Kholin's Soulcaster and save House Davar.
Kaladin is born late in 1153.
Kaladin is born late in 1153 to Lirin and Hesina.

art.alt: A dark-haired woman in blue stands at the curtained entrance of a lamplit reading alcove where a red-haired girl sits at a desk piled with books.

summary.text: After proving herself, Shallan became Jasnah's ward, secretly meaning to steal her Soulcaster.

art.alt: Young Kal, blood on his face and shirt, holding a tray of surgical bottles and bandages.

summary.text: At eight, Kal begins training in surgery with his father, though he dreams of being a soldier.
Shallan drew strange symbol-headed figures that weren't there.

art.alt: An armoured figure with a Shardblade on his shoulder stands silhouetted against a burning city.

summary.text: After an ambush, Dalinar has Rathalas burned in a rage of the Thrill. Evi, who had gone into the city, dies in the fire. Dalinar hides this and has it given out that she was assassinated and that the city burned in retribution.

art.alt: At night under a stone arch, a woman raises her hand as attacking thugs burst into fire and crystal, while a red-haired girl watches in horror.

summary.text: Jasnah killed four thugs in an alley; that night Shallan stole her Soulcaster.
Hearthstone's ailing citylord, Brightlord Wistiow, dies, having set aside spheres to pay for Kal's surgical studies.

events.title: Shallan enters a place of glass beads

art.alt: A sketch of tall, robed figures whose heads are twisting geometric symbols, gathered in a stone archway.

summary.text: Shallan slipped into a place of glass beads and turned a goblet to blood.
Wandering away from a gathering party, Eshonai comes upon a group of humans, the first her people have met.
Shallan and Kabsal were poisoned; she gave Jasnah back the stolen Soulcaster.
Kabsal poisoned Shallan; she gave back the stolen Soulcaster, and Jasnah saved her.
Kabsal, a Ghostblood, poisoned Shallan; she gave back the stolen Soulcaster, and Jasnah saved her.
Venli, learning her people's songs from her mother, hopes she has found a way to a new form. Then Eshonai returns with news: she has found humans.
Shallan confessed to Jasnah that she killed her father, and Jasnah took her back.
Seven years earlier, on an expedition south of the Shattered Plains, Dalinar meets a Parshendi patrol and sees they are intelligent and organized. He brings Gavilar to meet them.

art.alt: A sketchbook page: an enormous eye and shell-like bulk rising from the sea beside a small ship, with fish swimming around it.

summary.text: Sailing with Jasnah, Shallan saw a living pattern on her sketches.
Given a strange gemstone by a human visitor, Venli breaks it in a highstorm and releases a spren that promises to live inside her. Eshonai notices she has changed.

art.alt: Shallan kneels in a dark, glittering realm of beads beside a tall black spire, a faint glowing pattern hovering by her hand.

summary.text: Killers stabbed Jasnah, and Shallan Soulcast the Wind's Pleasure, sinking it.
Brightlord Roshone arrives as Hearthstone's new citylord. Sure that Lirin stole Wistiow's spheres, he sets out to squeeze the surgeon's family.
Stranded in the Frostlands, Shallan joined Tvlakv's caravan to the Shattered Plains.
Shallan recruited Vathah's deserters to fight bandits.

Eshonai comes to Kholinar with the listeners for the treaty. Gavilar shows her a strange sphere and speaks of bringing back the gods her people abandoned. Horrified, she tells the Five, who decide to have the king killed.

art.alt: A red-haired woman and an older woman stand on a rocky plain facing a mounted soldier in blue who looks down at them.

summary.text: Posing as a Horneater princess, Shallan talked Kaladin out of his boots.
Navani runs the feast in Kholinar celebrating the treaty with the Parshendi. After a bitter quarrel with Gavilar, she hears that he has been assassinated and goes to see his body.
Shallan killed Tyn with her Shardblade after Tyn learned who she was.
Venli is in the palace at Kholinar for the treaty signing. Caught wandering, she is told that Gavilar means to betray the listeners.
Shallan told Dalinar and Navani of Jasnah's death and met Adolin, her betrothed.

art.alt: A man in white walks from fallen guards down a palace hall, his hand over his face.

summary.text: On the night of a feast in Kholinar to celebrate a treaty with the Parshendi, an assassin in white, Szeth, kills King Gavilar, Dalinar's brother.
Posing as Tyn's apprentice, Shallan met the Ghostbloods; Mraize assigned her Amaram.

art.alt: A man in white walks from fallen guards down a palace hall, his hand over his face.

summary.text: Szeth, a Truthless of Shinovar bound to obey, is sent by the Parshendi to kill King Gavilar during the treaty feast in Kholinar. He fights his way through the palace and kills the king.

events.title: Shallan goes on a date with Adolin

summary.text: Shallan and Adolin had their first date at a winehouse.
Jasnah slips away from the treaty feast in Kholinar on business of her own. That night her father, King Gavilar, is assassinated.

art.alt: In a dim stone hall, a disguised figure in a cap lurks in shadow, watching a tall man in a long coat raise a great curved sword in a sunlit doorway.

summary.text: Shallan searched Amaram's manor and found his Shardblade had been Helaran's.

art.alt: Dalinar sits on the grass of a glowing forest, facing a spren made of vines.

summary.text: Travelling to the Shattered Plains after Gavilar's death, Dalinar goes to the Valley to ask the Nightwatcher for forgiveness. Cultivation offers to prune him instead. He accepts and loses all memory of his wife.

art.alt: Two Shardbearers fight side by side in a sandy arena, one in Shardplate, the other a spearman in blue.

summary.text: With Kaladin's help, Adolin beat four Shardbearers in a duel.

art.alt: Kal and Tien in green army uniforms, holding spears, on a battlefield.

summary.text: When Brightlord Amaram comes recruiting, Roshone has Tien drafted to spite Lirin. Kal enlists too, to keep his younger brother safe.
Shallan questioned a madman in the ardents' temple and overheard Amaram.

art.alt: Kaladin kneels on a battlefield among spears, holding his brother.

summary.text: Tien's untrained squad is pushed to the front as bait. Kaladin fights his way across the battlefield but reaches his brother too late.

art.alt: A sketchbook page of strange chasm plants and creatures: long flowering vines, coral-like fronds and many-legged crawlers, with a tiny figure holding a spear at the bottom.

summary.text: Shallan and Kaladin fell into the chasms when a bridge collapsed.
Shallan and Kaladin fell into the chasms; Kaladin killed a chasmfiend with her Shardblade.
Shallan and Kaladin fell into the chasms; Kaladin killed a chasmfiend with her Shardblade, and she told him she killed her father.
Rysn travels with her babsk, Vstim, to trade with the Shin.

events.title: Shallan joins the battle at Narak

summary.text: During the battle at Narak, Shallan went with Renarin to find the Oathgate.
After Kaladin's last battle in Amaram's army, Amaram has the surviving squadmates killed, takes the battle's Shards for himself, and spares Kaladin only to brand him a slave.

art.alt: Seen from above, a red-haired woman and a young man rush across a mosaic floor inside a domed building ringed by carved figures, she reaching out with a glowing hand.

summary.text: Shallan found the Oathgate in the Plains' central ruins.
Shallan opened the Oathgate and took the armies to Urithiru.
Mraize found Shallan in Urithiru, knowing she was Veil.
With Vstim too ill to trade, Rysn must deal with the Reshi on one of their living islands herself.

events.title: Shallan joins the hunt for a killer

summary.text: Shallan joined Adolin's investigation into Sadeas' murder.

events.title: Shallan explores the Breakaway as Veil

summary.text: As Veil, Shallan searched the Breakaway's taverns for the killer.
In Kharbranth, Jasnah meets Shallan, who has followed her across Roshar asking to be her ward. Jasnah reluctantly agrees on trial.
Shallan chased a strange dark figure through Urithiru.

art.alt: Kaladin slumped in a slaver's cage at dusk, a windspren drifting past.

summary.text: The slaver Tvlakv sells Kaladin to Highprince Sadeas's army on the Shattered Plains, where he is assigned to Bridge Four, the crew with the worst losses.

art.alt: In a dark cavern, a red-haired woman in blue raises a blazing light against a vast mass of black tendrils, while soldiers in the foreground hold back.

summary.text: Shallan drove the Unmade Re-Shephir out of Urithiru.

art.alt: In the rain, Rock and Teft carry a bloodied Kaladin between them, a windspren curling around them.

summary.text: Bridge Four's side carry shields the crew, but other crews copy it badly and Sadeas's assault fails. Blamed, Kaladin is hung outside to face a highstorm, and survives.

art.alt: A dark-haired woman in blue embraces a weeping red-haired girl, light on one side and grey, eye-filled shapes on the other.

summary.text: Jasnah returned alive to Urithiru.

art.alt: Dalinar in Shardplate, Blade in hand, faces a huge chasmfiend on the plateaus.

summary.text: On a hunt on the Shattered Plains with King Elhokar and Sadeas, a chasmfiend attacks. Dalinar risks his life to save his nephew.
As Veil, Shallan recruited Ishnah, a spy who had trailed her.

art.alt: Dalinar in Shardplate, Blade in hand, faces a huge chasmfiend on the plateaus.

summary.text: On a hunt with Dalinar, Renarin, Elhokar and Sadeas, Adolin goes for the chasmfiend's legs in his Shardplate as it attacks, and the king is nearly crushed when his saddle strap breaks.
Shallan and Kaladin opened the Thaylen City Oathgate.
Navani, the king's mother, arrives at the warcamps on the Shattered Plains and joins the king's feast.

events.title: Shallan joins the Cult of Moments

summary.text: As Veil, Shallan joined the Cult of Moments on the Oathgate platform.

art.alt: A lone figure with a spear in the bottom of a deep red chasm.

summary.text: Sent to permanent chasm duty, Bridge Four starts training in secret with spears under Kaladin, with Teft overseeing, hoping to fight their way to freedom.
Wit told Shallan the story of the Girl Who Looked Up.
When eight highprinces refuse his call for joint assaults, leaving only Sadeas, Dalinar tells Navani he is considering abdicating to Adolin. She urges him to stay.

events.title: Shallan fights in the fall of Kholinar

summary.text: Shallan touched the Unmade at the Oathgate, and it pulled back.
King Taravangian joins Jasnah and Shallan for lunch on their balcony and asks Shallan to draw him.
Shallan activated the Kholinar Oathgate despite a warning that it was a trap.
Shallan activated the Kholinar Oathgate, and it took the team into Shadesmar.

art.alt: Two armies clash on a plateau under a storm of arrows; riders lead the charge.

summary.text: Highprinces Dalinar and Sadeas begin attacking plateaus together, with Sadeas's bridge crews running for both armies. Their first joint assault succeeds.
Shallan wove an illusory army on Thaylen Field to hold off the enemy.

art.alt: Two armies clash on a plateau under a storm of arrows; riders lead the charge.

summary.text: Highprinces Dalinar and Sadeas begin attacking plateaus together, with Sadeas's bridge crews running for both armies. Their first joint assault succeeds.
Shallan married Adolin in Urithiru.
Shallan married Adolin at Urithiru while her mother, the Herald Chana, watched among the servants.
On his master's orders, Szeth kills King Hanavanar of Jah Keved and his guests at a banquet.
As Chanasha, Shallan denounced Dalinar to attract the Sons of Honor.
Jasnah lures thugs into an alley and kills them with her Soulcaster, to teach Shallan a lesson. Shallan, meanwhile, swaps her Soulcaster for a fake.
As Veil, Shallan met Ialai Sadeas, who died of poison soon after.
As Veil, Shallan met Ialai Sadeas; as Radiant, she poisoned her.
Teft tricks Kaladin into drawing in Stormlight without thinking, then shows him what he has done. Shaken, Kaladin goes off alone to think it over.

events.title: Shallan offers to lead an envoy

art.alt: A man and a red-haired woman in a long coat cross a strange shore of glowing crystal plants under a purple sky, a dark monolith far behind.

summary.text: Shallan volunteered to lead a mission to the honorspren with Adolin.
Navani realises that Dalinar speaks the Dawnchant, a dead language, during his visions, which shows they are real.

art.alt: Great finned, flying creatures pull a boat by long ropes across a dark sea toward a tall, sheer monolith.

summary.text: Mraize sent Shallan a dagger to trap the Herald Kelek's soul.
Listening to Dalinar during a highstorm vision, Navani realises he is speaking the Dawnchant, a dead language, which shows the visions are real.
During Adolin's trial, the persona Formless took control of Shallan.
Jasnah discovers Shallan's theft. Shallan confesses why she came, and Jasnah decides they must travel to the Shattered Plains.
Shallan turned back from killing Kelek, and Veil merged back into her.
Szeth comes to kill King Taravangian, who reveals that he has been Szeth's master all along, and adds Dalinar to the list.
Shallan broke with Mraize and refused to kill Kelek.

art.alt: Kaladin, glowing, leaps into a mass of enemy warriors with his spear.

summary.text: At the plateau called the Tower, Sadeas pulls back and leaves Dalinar's army trapped. Kaladin turns Bridge Four around and gives Dalinar and Adolin's men a way off the plateau.

art.alt: A sketchbook page of a full suit of ornate Shardplate beside two Shardblades, one straight and one curving into spirals, with handwritten notes about beads and plate sections.

summary.text: Shallan saved Adolin from a Shadesmar ambush, then reached Azimir in Shardplate, having sworn her Fourth Ideal.

art.alt: Kaladin, glowing, leaps into a mass of enemy warriors with his spear.

summary.text: Abandoned by Sadeas on the plateau called the Tower, Adolin leads the Kholin forces down the slope in a desperate charge, and Bridge Four brings a bridge to get them off.
The Ghostbloods attacked Shallan's team at Dalinar's perpendicularity; Lieke died, and Mraize's dagger collapsed it.
Dalinar trades his Shardblade, Oathbringer, to Sadeas for the freedom of Kaladin and the bridgemen.

events.placeName: vision of the Davar estate (Spiritual Realm)
events.title: Shallan relives her mother's death

summary.text: Shallan relived the day her mother died and saw her mother speaking with Nale through a seon.
Shallan relived the day her mother died, then confronted her mother, Chana, in person and forgave her.
Shallan saw through a Lightweaving and killed Iyatil.
Shallan killed Iyatil, then outwitted and killed Mraize as he stabbed her.
Shallan killed Iyatil and Mraize, then integrated her persona Radiant.
Shallan killed Iyatil and Mraize and integrated Radiant, but was left stranded in Shadesmar.

art.alt: Under trees with flame-like orange blossoms, a dark-haired man in a dark coat sits on a rock talking to a red-haired girl.

summary.text: Wit brought Shallan Davar's father word from her brother Helaran, then comforted Shallan.

events.placeName: Off the coast of the Frostlands
events.title: Attack on the ship

summary.text: Assassins attack the Wind's Pleasure at night and stab Jasnah through the heart.

events.title: Wit insults guests at Elhokar's feast

art.alt: A dark-haired man in a black coat leans toward an elegantly dressed couple on a walkway between pavilions, pointing and grinning.

summary.text: As King Elhokar Kholin's Wit, he insulted the arriving guests and warned Dalinar Kholin his talk of retreat had spread.

art.alt: Amaram in a green and red uniform, holding a Shardblade.

summary.text: Kaladin tests his Surgebinding in the chasms with Sigzil, Rock and Lopen, then returns to camp to hear that Amaram, the man who branded him, has come to the Shattered Plains.

events.title: Wit tells Kaladin the Wandersail story

art.alt: A man in black plays a flute by a fire on a rocky ledge at dusk while a young spearman listens; a ghostly sailing ship rides the clouds above.

summary.text: Wit told Kaladin the story of the Wandersail and gave him his flute.

art.alt: A huge bare-chested man with long matted hair stands in a dark gateway, holding a large Shardblade.

summary.text: Wit was waiting in Kholinar when Talenel arrived with a Shardblade, warned of a Desolation and collapsed.
Wit was waiting in Kholinar when Talenel arrived with a Shardblade, warned of a Desolation and collapsed. Wit and Bordin later brought him to the Shattered Plains.
With Renarin and Navani helping him into his Shardplate, Adolin fights his first duel under Dalinar's plan to win the other highprinces' Shards.

events.title: Wit greets Jasnah back from Shadesmar

summary.text: Wit waited for Jasnah Kholin to return from Shadesmar and offered to pool their knowledge.

events.title: Wit tells the Girl Who Looked Up

art.alt: In a dim wooden room, a man sits on the floor beside a young woman curled up against the wall.

summary.text: In Kholinar, Wit found Shallan Davar and told her the story of the Girl Who Looked Up.
Kaladin meets Shallan Davar for the first time, and she tricks him out of his new boots.

events.title: Wit finds a Cryptic in Kholinar

summary.text: After Kholinar fell, Wit stayed behind and coaxed a Cryptic out of the palace ruins.
Wit goaded Highprince Ruthar into challenging him, then named Queen Jasnah Kholin his champion.
At Narak, Eshonai goes out into a highstorm with a captured spren and takes stormform, the form Venli's scholars have rediscovered.

events.title: Wit tells Kaladin the Dog and the Dragon

summary.text: In a nightmare sent by Odium, Wit told Kaladin the story of the Dog and the Dragon.
At Narak, Eshonai takes stormform, the form Venli's scholars have rediscovered. Venli tells her they can now summon a storm against their enemies.

events.title: Wit drafts Dalinar's contract with Odium

summary.text: After the victory in Emul, Wit showed Jasnah Kholin his draft of a contest-of-champions contract with Odium.

art.alt: In a pillared hall, two men with a Shardblade and a spear face a glowing figure in white.

summary.text: Warned by Kaladin, Dalinar flees the palace with the king, but Szeth breaks in and says he has come for Dalinar. Dalinar catches Szeth's Shardblade between his palms, and Kaladin knocks Szeth out through the wall.

events.title: Wit meets Odium at the Pinnacle

summary.text: Odium confronted Wit over the contract; Wit learned his enemy was no longer Rayse, and Odium erased that memory.

art.alt: In a pillared hall, two men with a Shardblade and a spear face a glowing figure in white.

summary.text: When Szeth attacks the palace, Adolin stays with Dalinar and Kaladin to fight him, and is Lashed to the ceiling.
In Urithiru, Wit taught Kaladin the flute and told him to go and live his own story.

art.alt: In a pillared hall, two men with a Shardblade and a spear face a glowing figure in white.

summary.text: When Szeth attacks the palace, Dalinar orders Renarin to take the king and flee.
At the monarchs' meeting in Urithiru, Wit explained the contract's loophole about capitals and concluded a new Vessel held Odium.

art.alt: In a pillared hall, two men with a Shardblade and a spear face a glowing figure in white.

summary.text: Szeth breaks into the king's palace in the warcamps to kill Dalinar. Dalinar catches his Shardblade between his palms, and a bridgeman knocks Szeth out through the wall.
Deep in Urithiru, Wit gave Dalinar and Navani an anchor to enter the Spiritual Realm.
Deep in Urithiru, Wit gave Dalinar and Navani an anchor to enter the Spiritual Realm; he caught Lift, but Gav was lost.

art.alt: In a pillared hall, two men with a Shardblade and a spear face a glowing figure in white.

summary.text: Warned by Syl, Kaladin helps Dalinar and the king flee when Szeth attacks. His arm is severed, but he pushes Szeth and Dalinar through a hole in the wall, survives the fall and heals himself with Stormlight.

art.alt: In a hall in purple light, a woman in a hovering chair with a small winged creature recoils as rainbow light surges between her and a white-haired man.

summary.text: In Urithiru, Wit met Rysn, and their Dawnshards began to pull together until he stopped it.

events.title: Wit walks Dalinar up the tower

summary.text: Wit walked Dalinar up Urithiru, telling him a story about a king and a lumberman's son.
Wit walked Dalinar up Urithiru, telling him a story, and said the contest's outcome was hidden from him and likely from Odium.
In Urithiru, Wit passed his Dawnshard to Sigzil, then Retribution killed him.
Moash takes Kaladin to meet Graves and his conspirators, who ask him to help assassinate King Elhokar. He hesitantly agrees, to Syl's dismay.
Moash takes Kaladin to meet his new friends, a group led by Graves who plan to kill the king.
Shallan and Adolin, newly betrothed, meet for lunch in the warcamps.
On a plateau, Adolin goes to a parley with Eshonai in his father's place. She says there will only be peace when one side is wiped out.

art.alt: Kaladin in a blue coat stands in the dueling arena between armored Shardbearers.

summary.text: When Adolin faces four Shardbearers in a duel, Kaladin leaps into the arena to help him win. He then publicly challenges Amaram for his crimes, and the humiliated king has him imprisoned.

art.alt: Kaladin in a blue coat stands in the dueling arena between armored Shardbearers.

summary.text: Dalinar's plan to beat Sadeas through Adolin's duel falls apart when Kaladin accuses Amaram. Dalinar stops the king from executing Kaladin, who is jailed instead.

art.alt: Kaladin in a blue coat stands in the dueling arena between armored Shardbearers.

summary.text: Adolin agrees to duel four Shardbearers at once and is losing until Renarin and Kaladin leap into the arena. Together they win.

art.alt: Kaladin in a blue coat stands in the dueling arena between armored Shardbearers.

summary.text: When Adolin faces four Shardbearers at once, Renarin joins him in the arena, followed by Kaladin.
In stormform, Eshonai takes control of the listeners at Narak and prepares them for the coming Alethi attack.
Lift and a band of thieves sneak into the Bronze Palace in Azimir, where she saves Gawx from an assassin and sees him crowned.
At the battlefield outside Vedenar, the dying Highprince Valam names Taravangian his heir, and Taravangian becomes king of Jah Keved.
Szeth meets Taravangian outside Vedenar to warn him that Dalinar has a Surgebinder.

art.alt: A huge, spiny chasmfiend crawls through a dark chasm.

summary.text: A sabotaged bridge drops Kaladin and Shallan into the chasms. With Syl gone and his powers failing, they share painful pasts, he kills a chasmfiend with her Shardblade, and they shelter from a highstorm in a cut alcove before making it back to camp.
At Narak, caught between two storms, Adolin duels Eshonai and knocks her into a chasm, then sees Szeth arrive.
At Narak, Renarin leads the soldiers guarding Shallan as she searches the plateau for a way out, and cuts into a strange rock mound for her.
As the Alethi armies reach Narak, Eshonai fights them in stormform. She duels Adolin, but grows reckless and he knocks her into a chasm.
Having spoken the Third Ideal to save the king, Kaladin flies out to Narak, where the Alethi armies are caught between two storms, and fights Szeth high above the battle.
At Narak, caught between two storms, Dalinar leads the Alethi armies. Kaladin catches him when Szeth drops him from the sky, and Shallan opens the Oathgate to get the armies out.
Navani goes with the army to Narak to set up her fabrials and help with the plan, as two storms converge on the battlefield.
Szeth comes to Narak to kill Dalinar and drops him from the sky, but Kaladin catches him. The two fight through the storms, and Kaladin wins.
While the armies are at Narak, Moash and Graves come for Elhokar in the warcamps. Kaladin tries to stop them, and Moash breaks his ribs.

art.alt: A vast tiered tower rises among snowy mountains, ringed by round platforms.

summary.text: After the battle, Kaladin and Bridge Four escape the storms through the Oathgate to Urithiru, the lost tower city of the Knights Radiant.

art.alt: A vast tiered tower rises among snowy mountains, ringed by round platforms.

summary.text: After the battle, Adolin and the armies escape the storms through the Oathgate to Urithiru, the lost city of the Knights Radiant.

art.alt: A vast tiered tower rises among snowy mountains, ringed by round platforms.

summary.text: After the battle, Renarin and the armies escape the storms through the Oathgate to Urithiru, the lost city of the Knights Radiant.

art.alt: A vast tiered tower rises among snowy mountains, ringed by round platforms.

summary.text: After the battle, Navani and the armies escape the storms through the Oathgate to Urithiru, the lost city of the Knights Radiant.

art.alt: A vast tiered tower rises among snowy mountains, ringed by round platforms.

summary.text: In Urithiru, Dalinar climbs to the top of the tower, swears the Ideals of a Bondsmith and bonds the Stormfather.
Following a voidspren across the Shattered Plains, Venli searches for her sister and finds Eshonai's Shardblade.
Exploring Urithiru, Adolin runs into Sadeas, who mocks his father. Adolin kills him and tells no one.
Jasnah comes back from the Cognitive Realm, where Wit is waiting for her.
Lift arrives in Yeddaw, a city cut into the ground, and finds an orphanage where children are being healed. She saves its keeper, the Stump, from Darkness.

art.alt: Dalinar and Navani hold hands beneath the Stormfather's face in the night sky.

summary.text: With no ardent willing to marry them, Dalinar asks the Stormfather, who appears to all and receives his and Navani's vows.

art.alt: Dalinar and Navani hold hands beneath the Stormfather's face in the night sky.

summary.text: With no ardent willing to marry them, Navani and Dalinar ask the Stormfather, who receives their vows.

art.alt: Kaladin kneels in a windswept field under a stormy sky, ribbons of wind around him.

summary.text: Kaladin flies to Hearthstone to warn his family of the Everstorm, but arrives after it has struck. He reunites with his parents, punches Roshone for Moash's sake and meets his baby brother, Oroden, then sets out after the town's escaped parshmen.
A murder in Urithiru copies the way Adolin killed Sadeas. Dalinar puts Adolin on the investigation, and Shallan begins exploring the tower.

art.alt: Two parshmen sit together on the grass, one writing.

summary.text: Tracking the escaped parshmen, Kaladin finds them frightened and playing cards rather than monstrous, and surrenders instead of fighting them.
Taravangian comes through the Oathgate to Urithiru with his head scribe, seeming slow and needing her prompting. He brings a Dustbringer, Malata.
Shallan, Adolin and Renarin lead soldiers into the tower's depths to face the Unmade lurking there. Shallan faces it and drives it away.

art.alt: Kaladin holds back a dark storm with one glowing hand, a child clinging to him.

summary.text: In Revolar, a red-eyed Fused appears and Kaladin flees. Caught by the storm, he shields a group of townspeople until they reach shelter, and the winds carry him to Urithiru.
Jasnah, thought dead, arrives in Urithiru and is reunited with Navani and Shallan.
Fleeing with Graves, Moash's group is attacked by Fused.

Back at Urithiru, Kaladin holds try-outs on the Shattered Plains, training Bridge Four and new recruits to draw Stormlight. He helps Hobber heal his legs, and they rescue a caravan carrying Rock's family.
Venli waits for the Everstorm with eight others chosen for something greater. Something pushes against her soul, but a voice claims her, and something else enters.
In Urithiru, scholars study a hidden library of gemstones, and Jasnah finds Renarin watching them.
As a vision ends, Odium appears to Dalinar. He says he means to kill Cultivation too, turns down a contest of champions, and shows Dalinar his true power.
Once Queen Fen agrees, Kaladin flies Shallan to Thaylen City to unlock its Oathgate.
Dalinar goes through the new Oathgate to Thaylen City. There he uses his Bondsmith powers to mend a ruined temple, and Queen Fen agrees to join his coalition.
Renarin comes through the new Oathgate to Thaylen City and heals the injured there.
Taken by the singers, Moash marches with parshmen hauling supplies, and realises they are going to invade Kholinar.

art.alt: Kaladin, Elhokar, Adolin and Shallan plan around a table in a sunlit room.

summary.text: Kaladin flies Elhokar, Adolin, Shallan and others above a highstorm to Kholinar. Disguised, they slip into the city and shelter at Adolin's tailor's house.

art.alt: Kaladin, Elhokar, Adolin and Shallan plan around a table in a sunlit room.

summary.text: Kaladin flies Elhokar, Adolin, Shallan and others above a highstorm to Kholinar. Disguised by Shallan, they slip into the city and shelter at Adolin's tailor's house.

art.alt: Lift, perched on the back of a sofa, hands Dalinar a bowl of food in an Azish room.

summary.text: Dalinar travels to Azimir through the Oathgate and learns Azish through the Stormfather. With essays from Fen, Navani and Jasnah, he persuades the viziers to visit Urithiru. On his return, he suddenly remembers everything about the Rift.
When Dalinar comes to Azimir to win over the viziers, Lift is there, eating his sausages.
After days pulling sledges, Moash reaches Kholinar with the singers' army.
On Elhokar's orders, Kaladin joins Kholinar's Wall Guard, whose soldiers welcome him with a free meal, and meets their leader, Highmarshal Azure.
Fighting for the Fused in the battle for Kholinar's palace, Moash runs King Elhokar through with a spear in front of Kaladin.

art.alt: Moash in a dark coat holds a bloodied spear.

summary.text: In the assault on the palace, Kaladin rescues Elhokar's young son but freezes as his friends fight on both sides. Moash kills Elhokar in front of him, and when Shallan activates the Oathgate the group finds itself in Shadesmar.

art.alt: Moash in a dark coat holds a bloodied spear.

summary.text: In the assault on the palace, Adolin fights his way toward the Oathgate. When Shallan activates it, the group finds itself in Shadesmar.
With Dalinar withdrawn, Navani leads the first meeting of the coalition of monarchs in Urithiru.
As a Skybreaker squire, Szeth is tested at the Purelake, hunting escaped convicts.

At Vedenar, Dalinar feels the Thrill for the first time in years. Fleeing it, he is declared excommunicated by ardents and forces the Oathgate to work without a Shardblade. Back in Urithiru, he starts drinking again.
Taravangian joins Dalinar as he surveys war-torn Vedenar, carrying a great shield fitted with a fabrial.
Fused carry Venli to Kholinar, where she is told her work is just beginning: telling her people's story to the singers.

art.alt: Dalinar and Venli fall through a shattering vision of a city filled with golden light.

summary.text: In a vision, Dalinar asks Venli for a truce. She demands Alethkar. Odium breaks into the vision and tells Dalinar there will be peace once Dalinar has destroyed the world.

art.alt: Dalinar and Venli fall through a shattering vision of a city filled with golden light.

summary.text: Venli is pulled into one of Dalinar's visions, where he asks for a truce. When Odium breaks in, she falls out of the vision onto the floor of her cave in Marat.
During the battle at Thaylen City, Rysn and Vstim are robbed of the King's Drop, a great ruby.
During the battle at Thaylen City, Navani forces her way through a blocked stairwell toward Dalinar, fights off her captors with a fabrial, and watches gloryspren stream toward him.
Back from Shadesmar, Kaladin arrives in time to block Amaram's killing blow at Dalinar. He fights the transformed, empowered Amaram while fending off Fused, until Rock shoots Amaram with an arrow.
At Thaylen City, Dalinar refuses to give Odium his past, swears the Third Ideal and joins the three Realms, bringing the missing Radiants back. He then goes into the red mist and traps the Thrill.
Szeth watches the battle at Thaylen City with Nin, then fights with Nightblood drawn. With Lift's help, he sets out to recover the stolen ruby.
During the battle at Thaylen City, Jasnah finds Renarin in a temple, then fights with him at the broken city wall.
Adolin fights hidden among Shallan's illusions to reach the Oathgate. Badly wounded, he tells her to go and save the city.
During the battle at Thaylen City, Renarin sees visions in a temple. He fights with Jasnah at the city wall, then saves Adolin from a Thunderclast.
Lift slips through the enemy army at Thaylen City, heals Szeth and helps him master Nightblood.
Venli lands with Odium's army at Thaylen City and watches the battle. Afterwards she tries to slip away with her spren and leaves on a retreating ship.
After the battle at Thaylen City, Taravangian tells Dalinar he had planned to seize the coalition if the Alethi fell.
Working the rubble of Kholinar's palace, Moash is praised for killing Elhokar and offered a new task by the Fused: to kill a god.
Jasnah walks into a meeting in Urithiru wearing the crown of Alethkar.
Shallan's brothers arrive in Urithiru as she waits to marry Adolin.
Rysn sets out from Thaylen City as owner of the Wandersail, bound on an expedition for the coalition.
The Wandersail breaks through the storm surrounding Akinah.

art.alt: Renarin, glowing, steps between Moash and a fallen Kaladin in a burning room.

summary.text: Now a highmarshal, Kaladin returns to Hearthstone and barely survives a Fused who travels as a streak of light, then brings an airship to evacuate the whole town. In the manor's cellar he finds Moash killing Roshone, and freezes when Moash urges him to kill himself, until Renarin brings him back to the ship.

art.alt: Renarin, glowing, steps between Moash and a fallen Kaladin in a burning room.

summary.text: Moash comes to Hearthstone with the Fused, kills Roshone and urges Kaladin to kill himself, until Renarin steps in.
Lift comes to Hearthstone with the Edgedancers on the Fourth Bridge to heal the wounded and move people to the ship.

art.alt: Renarin, glowing, steps between Moash and a fallen Kaladin in a burning room.

summary.text: Renarin comes to Hearthstone with the Fourth Bridge. He finds Kaladin frozen in front of Moash, steps in and brings him back to the ship.
As Veil, Shallan questions Ialai Sadeas in her camp on the Shattered Plains. Before Shallan can act, Ialai is poisoned.
In Kholinar, Venli serves as a Voice to the Fused and attends a conclave of the most important singers in the city.

art.alt: Kaladin and Zahel spar among billowing sheets and colourful scarves.

summary.text: Relieved of active duty by Dalinar, Kaladin hands his roles to Sigzil and Skar. Zahel beats him in a sparring match and tells him he can't become an ardent, as he still loves the fight.

art.alt: Notebook sketches of the Fourth Bridge airship.

summary.text: Kaladin meets the airship Fourth Bridge and brings his parents to their new rooms at Urithiru. When he admits he has retired, his father has him join his surgery.
At a coalition meeting in Urithiru, Dalinar proposes an attack on Emul, and Shallan and Adolin volunteer to lead a mission to the honorspren. Navani is to stay and run the tower.
Kaladin and Teft track down Noril, a former patient the ardents have locked away in a dark corridor. Kaladin sees himself in him and resolves to find a new way to help men like him.
Taravangian says goodbye to his friends in Urithiru before leaving for Emul with Dalinar and Jasnah, and disbands the Diagram.
With his armies in Emul, Taravangian waits for Odium's signal to betray the coalition.

When the Fused seize Urithiru, its Radiants fall unconscious, Teft among them, but Kaladin stays awake. When soldiers come for the fallen Radiants, he fights, kills a Regal and flees with Teft into hiding high in the tower.
When the Fused invade Urithiru, Navani tries to defend the tower with the Sibling's help, but is forced to surrender.
Venli enters Urithiru with the invading Fused and goes with Raboniel through the tower.
When the tower falls, Lift stays awake, and is caught and held in a cage.

Helped by the tower's spren, the Sibling, Kaladin spies on the Oathgates. When the Fused find one of the tower's hidden nodes, he outwits the Pursuer and destroys it, but his healing has begun to fail.
In the war camp in Emul, Ruthar challenges Wit, and Jasnah fights as his champion. She strikes Ruthar down, has Renarin heal him and strips him of his title.
In the occupied tower, Venli visits Rlain in his cell, tells him she has saved Kaladin's family and promises to get him out.
Wearing dulled Shardplate, Jasnah goes into battle in Emul and ends up using her powers.
When the Fused find another node, in a well, Kaladin evades the Pursuer, dives in and destroys it, then escapes onto the tower's outside in a highstorm.
Imprisoned in Emul after his betrayal, Taravangian tells Dalinar he did it to save Kharbranth.
A prisoner in her own tower, Navani works with Raboniel and learns that Stormlight responds to sound.
The coalition wins the last battle of its campaign in Emul. Walking the battlefield, Dalinar promises the Mink they will free Herdaz once Alethkar is free.
The coalition wins its campaign in Emul. Szeth walks the battlefield with Dalinar.
Jasnah gets word in her tent of the coalition's victory in Emul.

art.alt: A watercolour dog looks up at a great blue dragon.

summary.text: Collapsed and barely alive, Kaladin finds himself in a dark, strange place, where Wit hides him for a while and tells him a story.
Absorbed in her search for the opposite of Light, Navani is named Voice of Lights by Raboniel.
Navani finds the exact tone that cancels Odium's rhythm and pushes Voidlight out of a sphere, then hides the discovery.
With Teft's help, Lift sneaks into the tower's Radiant infirmary while Kaladin fights the Pursuer.

art.alt: Kaladin hurtles through a dusty sky, spear in hand, wrapped in streaks of blue light.

summary.text: Healed by Lift, Kaladin defeats the Pursuer, then finds Teft killed by Moash. Atop the tower he jumps, meaning to die. A vision of Tien helps him accept loss, and still falling he speaks the Fourth Ideal as windspren form his Shardplate.
In the tower's heart, Navani speaks the Ideals of a Bondsmith and bonds the Sibling, freeing Urithiru.
In Urithiru, Moash hunts Teft and Lift through the Radiant infirmary and kills Teft.

Dalinar flies with Szeth and Windrunners to Tukar to confront Ishar. Ishar calls him Odium's champion, beats the Windrunners and tries to take Dalinar's bond to the Stormfather until Szeth drives him off.
Szeth flies with Dalinar and Windrunners to Tukar to confront Ishar, and drives Ishar off when he attacks Dalinar's bond.

Odium draws Dalinar into a vision, and they agree on a contest of champions in eleven days. If Dalinar's champion wins, Odium returns Alethkar and Herdaz. If Odium's wins, he keeps his conquests and takes Dalinar's soul.
Venli leads her group from Urithiru to the listeners on the Shattered Plains and is let into their camp to see her mother.
Kaladin says goodbye to Bridge Four in Urithiru, then meets Szeth at the Oathgate and leaves with him.
At Azimir, Kaladin meets Shallan and Adolin, then sets out for Shinovar with Szeth at the front of a highstorm.
Back from Shadesmar through the Oathgate at Azimir, Shallan and Adolin meet Kaladin, then go on to Urithiru.
Navani explores her new bond with the Sibling in Urithiru, and learns she must not leave the tower for long.
In Urithiru, with the contest of champions eight days away, Dalinar hears that the singers are attacking Azimir.
Kaladin and Szeth fly into Shinovar through a pass in the Misted Mountains.
Jasnah meets privately with Dalinar, Navani and Queen Fen in Urithiru as the coalition plans its defence.
Outside Urithiru, Renarin watches Rlain tend the crops.
Adolin goes through the Oathgate to Azimir to help defend its Oathgate dome against the coming singer army.
In Shinovar, Kaladin and Szeth find Szeth's family homestead.
At the Stoneward monastery, Szeth fights Rit, who holds an Honorblade.
Jasnah arrives in Thaylen City with her army to help defend it.
With Nale now travelling with them, Kaladin and Szeth make for the Lightweaver monastery, halfway through Szeth's journey.
Venli leads a group of her people and several chasmfiends through the chasms of the Shattered Plains, following a hidden song.
Adolin wakes after the fighting at Azimir, healed but missing his right leg.
Venli's group reaches the central plateaus of Narak with a battle raging above them.
In Thaylen City, Jasnah and Queen Fen meet Odium to debate the city's fate.
At a ruined monastery, Kaladin fights Nale while Szeth watches.
Venli and the listeners mount chasmfiends to attack on the Shattered Plains.
On his peg leg, Adolin holds a place in the pike line defending Azimir.
Travelling by wagon with Nale, Kaladin and Szeth reach the Bondsmith monastery, where Szeth's journey ends.
Dalinar climbs to the top of Urithiru to face Odium's champion in the contest.
